question: Do current assembled maps and their served temporal runtime preserve all unrelated saved science and use only exact specimen-owned intervals for corrected animal occurrence?
execution_precondition: The separately frozen actual saved-animal producer and independent observer must pass before this map producer starts; install no unqualified output.
assembly: Decode authenticated existing static layers/details/signals/edges/sequences; replace only animal locality point layers with the independently qualified current native saved-metadata consumer; retain source chronology context exactly. Use existing owning static writer, contract publisher, playback publisher and finalize_bundle to emit current runtime/controllers and transport. No collection/master/normalizer/model/chronology census rerun.

New legitimate animal layer keys may be appended in native builder order; retain relative order of existing unrelated layers. Preserve country/version/date and other metadata except necessary owned animal counts/contracts/runtime/staticinventory/buildIDs. Every actual saved animal specimen packet and coordinate must exactly match its qualified consumer output.
guards: Freeze HEAD/index/alltrackedpackagefiles including JS/HTML/schema, complete data/adna tree, all three existing map trees and actual opened resources; pin both artifact assembly scripts plus this protocol. Reject network and any write outside absent root-artifact destination. Preserve inputs through producer and independent readback. Original constraints and failed attempts stay visible.
wire_budget_semantics: Retain all original declared static and interaction/latency budgets. Validate byte/request constraints with maintained writers. An advertised budget is not a measured query or latency result; claim no new latency qualification without measuring it.
independent_observation: Decode every candidate and compare preserved payloads to authenticated original maps, exact changed animal records to qualified saved-consumer products and full index ownership/postings to a fresh independently derived reference. Runtime must be served in actual existing Chromium with authenticated source bytes/buildID; evaluate actual loaded closure functions via CDP breakpoint and restore state. Source-backed animal/SEAD positives and gaps plus explicit labelled synthetic null/zero/malformed/global-refusal controls retain independent expected interval arithmetic.
installation: Only after all corresponding independent identity/preservation/temporal checks pass, install exact declared owned outputs and remove only manifest-owned obsolete chunks/controllers. Never alter unrelated user files or copy external private source inputs.
unsupported_claims: New dates, ecological events or specimen identities
New field/source permission or scientific endorsement
New model, collection or source chronology census
Query latency, measured vegetation accuracy or propagation acceptance
retained_source_chronology: Rehydrate and reconcile the existing authenticated sidecar and exact decoded chronology layers through the maintained publication contract. Preserve each sidecar byte-for-byte with its original qualified snapshot/input identity; this is inherited source evidence, not a new current native census. Previously qualified source-caution followthrough preserves every date/identity and its nonmapped warning; do not relabel a historic census as a newly executed one.
